title: docs(releases): fold the changesets merged after b2c0752900 into the 18.1.0 notes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiRwWtsarkLPmw9fMYiFZ3LY)_

## Summary

The 18.1.0 notes (#25460) were compiled at `b2c0752900`. Twenty-three changesets have landed on `main` since then, before the cut. This PR folds them in. It changes docs only.

- **Breaking changes you must act on** gains four entries:
  - a bulk action `confirmText` that the template cannot fill (#25451)
  - a `runAs: 'system'` flow that writes identity objects (#25483)
  - an out-of-office delegation outside its own organization (#25439)
  - a rollback `toVersion` that is not a JSON whole number (#25532)
- **Semantic changes**: membership keys are now staged per request (#25528). Until now this section said there were none.
- **New capabilities**:
  - the `external` organization role (#25515)
  - `ObjectSchema.membershipKeys` (#25513)
  - the upgrade impact report (#25512)
  - `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_ORGANIZATION` (#25489)
  - the live mail transport statement (#25448)
- **Pins**: the scaffolds now write exact `@objectstack/*` pins (#25539). The upgrade checklist's pin step says how to move an older project off caret ranges.
- **Console**: the pin moves to `2958f17e9c6a`. That is eight refreshes, 130 entries, ten of them `minor`.
- **Counts**: 250 entries, split 77 / 9 / 47 / 1 / 116 across the five sections. 86 changesets are declared breaking, and 39 of them are graded `patch`. The counts are updated on the 18.1 page, the v18 index, the releases index and Backward Compatibility. `check-adr-0087-registration --list` confirms 86 out of 86.
- **Checklist**: steps 3 and 4 gain the new refusals.

The page still says it has not been walked. That changes after 18.1.0 publishes.
